title.en: Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Health) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Health) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 March 2024.

2. In this Order —
“MOH Permanent Secretary” means any Permanent Secretary to the Ministry of Health;
“MOH political office holder” means —
(a)any Second Minister for Health;
(b)any Minister of State assigned by the Prime Minister to assist the Minister for Health; and
(c)any Parliamentary Secretary assigned by the Prime Minister to assist the Minister for Health.
[S 173/2025 wef 20/03/2025]

2A. The Minister for Health, with the Prime Minister’s approval, delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the First Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the First Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the First Schedule.
[S 173/2025 wef 20/03/2025]

heading.en: Delegations to persons other than political office holders

text.en:
3. The Minister for Health delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the Second Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the Second Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the Second Schedule.
[S 173/2025 wef 20/03/2025]
